key_insight: Change2Task turns real repository history into executable coding-agent tasks, creating verified problems from merged pull requests on later, healthy versions of the same codebase. This helps generate realistic tasks that are both grounded in real software evolution and automatically checkable.
problem_solved: Coding agents need a steady supply of realistic, executable tasks for training, benchmarking, and ongoing evaluation, but such data is hard to create because tasks must include a valid repo state, clear specs, development tools, and reliable verification.
method: Mine merged pull requests from repository history as task seeds.
Map each historical change onto a modern healthy revision of the same repository.
Reconstruct the task environment and verification so each task is executable and automatically validated.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, Change2Task provides a scalable way to produce higher-quality coding-agent benchmarks and training data. This can improve evaluation realism, support continuous testing, and better reflect the challenges agents face in real software development.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram from pull request history to verified task
Before/after repository timeline showing historical change vs modern revision
Icon set for code, tools, environment, and verification
Flowchart highlighting alignment, reconstruction, and validation steps
paper_title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
paper_authors: Haomin Qi, Xingliang Wang, Xuanqi Gao, Baihui Sang, Xin Zhang
